venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 2/20.** Garden: slow start picking up ~6pm with steady walk-ins; new menu layout well received, French 75 / Combat Rock gaining traction; tapered ~11:30, last call shortly after. D&C: strong pre-dinner crowd, lull, then reservations arrived ~9pm; host team kept the waitlist moving; fun moments for larger parties and birthdays. Kitchen: 10.29% of sales; oysters led; James solo on the line, food out quickly and to spec. MOD: Kevin / Cory / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: Chilly as is wont for this year :)
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 2/20.** First turn was quite slow (boosted by an 11 top bachelorette party more interested in gossip than ordering) and doomed the night from hitting goal, but hit a consistent stride until midnight. Crowd leaned simple/shaken palates. Favorite moment: recreating a returning guest's favorite D&C drink and serving it on a handwritten spec. Comps $120.55. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Wax Simulacra, Material Control. Door: slow start, small line, bar full at 6:45, again ~8pm, push toward 10pm; many 5+ tops walked in for the waitlist; the man who built the bar came in; current and former hosts visited; three English guests nearly ran out on their tab but Ellis caught them; full 10pm to close. No no-shows.
